value: Examines how a shared heritage trip to Poland for Israeli and American Jewish youth fosters religious-national identity exploration, exposing participants to diverse Jewish religious practices (e.g., Reform synagogue services).

evidence.supporting_text: ...participation in the journey gave rise to changes in various personal, social, and religious-national aspects of identity... A few of the participants said that attending religious services at the Reform synagogue in Rochester was a highlight that deepened their connection to Jewish identity...
